messages:
ashley: Heads-up: planning a small deploy to update monitoring dashboards + a minor alert threshold tweak for model-serving. Targeting 10:30am PT window. Anyone oncall or able to run smoke checks?
kevin: I can cover smoke checks. :thumbsup: What exactly is changing?
ashley: Two parts: 1) new Grafana panels for token latency per model (will add links), 2) Prometheus alert tweak — increase token-latency WARNING from 800ms -> 1100ms to cut noise; keep CRITICAL at 2000ms. Plan: merge infra PR then dashboards update. PRs: https://github.com/redwood/pr/4523 https://github.com/redwood/pr/4527
sanjay: Are we doing a canary? I suggest 5% traffic for 30m before ramp.
ashley: Yes — canary 5% for 30m, then 25% for 15m, then full if clean. Also enable traces sampling for the canary only. @maria can you watch traces + alerts?
maria: Yep available 10:25-11:15. I'll run the smoke checklist: - dashboard panels render - latency numbers look sane - no unexpected alert spam - traces capture example requests. I'll post results as ✅/❌.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: infra-pr #4523 merged -> deployment queued. ETA 10:32am PT. Canary: 5%.
ashley: Quick copy of alert rule we'll apply (just the changed parts):
```yaml
alert: TokenLatencyHighWarning
expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(token_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, model)) > 1.1
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: warning
annotations:
  summary: "Token latency p95 > 1.1s for {{ $labels.model }}"
```
kevin: One request: keep the old dashboard as "Latency (legacy)" for 24h after full rollout in case we need to flip back quickly.
ashley: Agree. We'll keep legacy for 24h. Rollback criteria: any CRITICAL alert firing >1min within a 5m window OR sustained 5xx spike >2x baseline. If triggered -> immediate rollback of the alert thresholds and routing.
sanjay: Who cuts the rollback? @ashley primary, or do we want ops to do it? If I see increased 5xxs I'll trigger.
ashley: I'll be primary for rollback but if I'm not reachable @sanjay is authorized to rollback. Rollback runbook: https://confluence.redwood/ops/rollbacks#monitoring-deploy
maria: Quick smoke-check commands I'll run: - open the new Grafana dash -> confirm panels load - run a few sample requests against canary endpoints and check traces - `kubectl get pods -n model-serving` to confirm canary pods healthy - check Prometheus Alerts panel for noise. I'll paste checklist results here.
kevin: Will finish PR review and address minor comments by 10:15, will mark approved.
ashley: Thanks — I'll post here when deploy starts and again when canary is healthy. Please keep pings on this thread for any findings so we have a single audit trail. :eyes:
